CustomField.description: What happens to unused credits when the period they were allocated for ends: No Rollover (they expire), Negotiable (only by mutual agreement - DC Advisory), Partial (a capped share rolls over - LionTree 20%), Full, or Not specified. Using credits any time within the term is not rollover. Applied from the order form extractions (ContractLegalTermsApplier); on an amendment a silent paper keeps it and a different answer flags legal review.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Do unused credits roll over into the next period or term?
CustomField.label: Credit Rollover
